errors.evidence: The peak for the 'ЕС' (EU) line in the 'Внос' (Import) chart occurs in 2012, not 2011.
In the 'Внос' (Import) chart, the 'Извън ЕС' (Non-EU) line starts at approximately 22% in 2004, not 25%.
In the 'Износ' (Export) chart, the peak for the 'ЕС' (EU) line is approximately 30% in 2011. In 2013, the value is lower (around 28%), so this is not the peak.
In the 'Износ' (Export) chart, the 'Извън ЕС' (Non-EU) line starts at approximately 37% in 2004, not 30%.
In the 'Износ' (Export) chart, the 'Извън ЕС' (Non-EU) line ends at 40% in 2019, not 32%.
